title: Sample equation satisfaction criterion
statement: For any natural numbers $n,\ell$, labeled sample $(x,b)\in\mathbb F_2^n\times\mathbb F_2$, and coefficient family on subsets of size at most $\ell$, the linear equation formed from the sample is satisfied by that family if and only if its low-degree polynomial evaluates at $x$ to $b$.
